about.heading: About me
about.body: Hi! I'm Giuly, a Software Engineer from Argentina. I build web and mobile applications with React, React Native, Node, Java, and plenty of other tools along the way. I enjoy challenges, I'm always eager to learn something new, and honestly, I like getting things done and seeing results ;)
about.outsideBody: As you can probably tell, I love tennis. I'm a big fan of sports in general, but I also love music, board games, Rubik's cubes, travelling, photography, movies, and books. I'm always finding a new hobby to get into.

contact.body: Let the balls settle, then click one to reach me.
